title: BriefCensus: code, run log, and result tables
description: Code, protocols, dated run log, and result tables for BriefCensus, a method that chooses permanent monitors for a rooftop photovoltaic fleet from a short temporary metering campaign. Raw data are not included and remain with their publishers.
